description: Change the plan for one session, including the day it is on: pass date to reschedule it ('move Sunday's run to Saturday'), time, title, type, duration_min, distance_m, elevation_m, notes or tags. Only the fields you send change. Recording a finished workout is log_session, not this. Where the user has Google Calendar connected, the event changes or moves there too. All dates are the user's local calendar dates (YYYY-MM-DD) in their own time zone. Requires signing in.

date.description: New local date, YYYY-MM-DD. This is how a session is rescheduled.

elevation_m.description: New planned vertical gain in metres.

notes.description: New plan notes; replaces the old ones.

session_id.description: id of the training session, from get_calendar, get_training_log or add_sessions.

tags.description: New tags; replaces the old ones, [] clears them.

time.description: New start time HH:mm, or empty string to clear it.

name: update_session
title: Change a session
